pkgmetadata.longdescription:
noVNC 1.6.0 with 20 Proxmox/pxvirt-specific patches. Provides the HTML5 VNC console used by pveproxy when a user opens the Console tab for a VM or container in the pxvirt web UI.
Do NOT replace with app-misc/novnc from the Gentoo tree. The Proxmox patches add PVE-specific UI code, WebSocket auth handling, custom fbresize events, command passthrough, clipboard integration, and other features that are required for correct pxvirt console operation.
Build produces a single ESM bundle (app.js) via esbuild from app/ui.js. The index.html.tpl template is served by pveproxy with per-VM substitutions.
pveproxy serves this package's files from /usr/share/novnc-pve/.
